what_it_does: Voice-activity detection (VAD) is the always-on listening feature that wakes devices when you speak. It drains batteries because it runs 24/7. This work achieves ultra-low power (161 nanowatts—like a single AA battery lasting decades) by combining two ideas: first, it compresses the audio data intelligently before processing, throwing away redundant information. Second, it uses spiking neural networks, which mimic biological brains by sending only occasional spike signals instead of processing every value, dramatically reducing power consumption while staying robust in noisy environments.
